usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the full QEMU VM configuration from a remote PVE node managed by PDM. The `state` parameter controls whether you get the pending (unapplied) or active (currently running) config — `pending` is the default and reflects the next-boot config. If you omit `node`, PDM resolves it automatically; supply it only when you know the VM's node to avoid an extra lookup. Requires `Resource.Audit` on the remote/vmid resource path.

examples.summary: Fetch the active running config of VM 101 on remote 'pve-hetzner'

tips: Use state=active when you need to inspect what the VM is currently running (e.g., after a live config change that hasn't been persisted).
Use state=pending (default) to see what config will be applied on next reboot — useful before migrating or snapshotting.
Pass `snapshot` to inspect the config frozen at a specific snapshot point rather than the current config.
Node auto-detection works well for healthy clusters; supply `node` explicitly if the cluster is partially degraded or you need deterministic routing.
